write_up: Your resume moves from Bridgepoint Analytics through senior marketing at Velocity Software to freelance consulting, with a senior marketing role as the next step. It's common for consulting work to be described broadly, but the current lines don't say enough about your part or what changed for clients. That makes the recent work less competitive in a pile, even with the strong Velocity experience behind it.

The MQL line at Velocity is your best model: it gives a year-over-year increase and pairs it with lower cost per lead. The team and budget line also makes your management remit tangible. Your resume explains why the Velocity role ended; the question now is what your consulting work has added.

Let's start with the freelance role. Pick a client project you can discuss, name your part and add a result if you can substantiate one. Then give the Bridgepoint traffic and webinar work the same concrete treatment as your Velocity results.
